IAS Officer Divya Mittal Resigns in Uttar Pradesh

Divya Mittal, an Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer in Uttar Pradesh, has resigned from her post. Mittal had previously worked in finance in London before joining the IAS. Her resignation has prompted public discussion and questions regarding the reasons behind her decision.
